entities.name: Online Dating & Algorithmic Matchmaking
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Match.com (1995) and subsequent apps (eHarmony, Tinder, Bumble, Hinge) transformed how people meet partners. By 2023, over 40% of US couples meet online — more than any other method. Algorithms now play matchmaker, replacing family, friends, and community.
